notes.title: Patch v.1.053 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]A new version has been released![/h1]

Please update your game to make sure you're on the latest version!

Changelog:
[list]
[*]Added the leaderboard!  You can now compare your best score with your Steam friends!
[*]Unlocked the Rider Mask. Now available to all players! (Reward for an event in [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/215280/]The Secret World[/url][/b] MMO)
[*]Corrected an issue that caused opened doors to not allow players to walk through them.
[*]Fixed an error where traps could trigger on the wrong player.
[*]The "Bookworm" achievement should now always unlock the '[b]Slash[/b]' zombie head.[/list]

notes.title: Patch v.1.052 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]A new version has been released![/h1]

Hide and Shriek has been updated!  Please be sure to patch your game to the latest version.  

Changes:
[list]
[*]Corrected an error that caused some players to not receive customizations when leveling up.  If this happened to you the first time you earn Experience, you will be fixed!
[*]Fixed an issue that caused audio to not play at all, or play to the wrong device.
[*]'[b]It Follows[/b]' will no longer despawn if you shriek and miss your opponent.
[*]Reduced the volume of splash screen cinematics.[/list]

notes.title: Patch v.1.051 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch 1.051 is now live![/h1]

Please make sure you update your client so you get the latest fixes!

[list]
[*]Reduced '[b]Scry[/b]' duration to 15 seconds (from 30 seconds)
[*]Reduced '[b]It Follows[/b]' duration to 20 seconds (from 30 seconds)
[*]Adjusted default quality settings to increase performance on lower end machines
[*]Various localization fixes
[*]Credits will now stop playing when a match starts
[*]Fixed a rare bug which could cause you to hold 2 orbs at once
[/list]

There is an issue with private matches that allow players from 2 different versions to still play each other.  If you notice anything above not working it is probably due to your friend having the wrong install.  Tell them to update!
